delivery: 40 care-worker and provider situation context refinements
alignment: Clarify the circumstance or constraint of existing human hypotheses independently of solutions; preserve needs→situations→existing-offerings hierarchy and click-to-drill.

before_after.title: Different professionals give conflicting instructions about the same resident
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker or A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Care decisions depend on outside advice, but the worker receives instructions that cannot all be followed.

before_after.title: I spend repeated calls explaining changes because there is no agreed update arrangement
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker or A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Relatives need updates while changes in care generate repeated calls without a shared communication plan.

before_after.title: I cannot distinguish constipation with overflow from the person's usual bowel pattern
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: An unfamiliar bowel pattern leaves the worker unsure how to describe the change or seek further assessment.

before_after.title: After a person dies I must immediately continue the round without time to process it
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The next visit still needs care while the worker has had no pause after a person’s death.

before_after.title: Discharge instructions do not explain who will supply equipment or follow-up care
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The person returns from another service without clear responsibility for equipment and continuing support.

before_after.title: Several people need help to the toilet at the same time during the night
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Night-time requests arrive together, leaving the worker to choose who receives assistance first.

before_after.title: The room or bathroom does not let me preserve privacy during care
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Intimate care must happen in a space where the person can be seen or interrupted.

before_after.title: A relative objects to a resident's relationship and asks me to prevent contact
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The worker is caught between a resident’s chosen contact and a relative’s request to stop it.

before_after.title: Different relatives give incompatible instructions about the same person's care
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker or A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: A shared care arrangement becomes difficult when family members expect different actions from the worker.

before_after.title: The household asks me to take on tasks beyond the agreed arrangement
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Extra household requests make the boundaries of the live-in care arrangement difficult to maintain.

before_after.title: A person asks for a different caregiver for intimate care but no alternative is arranged
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The person’s preference for intimate care cannot be met through the staff arrangement currently available.

before_after.title: A person is awake and distressed at night but I cannot establish what they need
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Night-time distress needs a response, but its cause and the person’s wishes are unclear to the worker.

before_after.title: The continence product leaks but I do not know whether its fit or the care plan should change
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: A leak leaves the worker unsure whether the product, its use or the wider support arrangement needs review.

before_after.title: I arrive at a locked door and cannot reach the client or an authorised contact
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: A scheduled home visit cannot begin, and nobody authorised to clarify access can be reached.

before_after.title: Relatives expect support that our team has not agreed or cannot provide
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker or A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The worker must explain the limits of the team’s care when relatives expect more support.

before_after.title: I work alone in people's homes with no colleague available for immediate advice
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: A difficult decision arises during a lone home visit without a colleague the worker can consult straight away.

before_after.title: I cannot identify who should clean, repair or replace equipment
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Care depends on equipment whose upkeep and replacement have no clear owner.

before_after.title: I am told to follow a routine that I believe is harming the person
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: An expected routine conflicts with the worker’s concern about the person’s welfare.

before_after.title: I cannot record and communicate an observation before the next worker takes over
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: A change noticed during care may not reach the next worker in time to inform their visit.

before_after.title: A person hints that someone takes their money but asks me not to tell anyone
before_after.previous_context: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The person’s request for secrecy conflicts with the worker’s concern about possible financial abuse.

before_after.title: An incident is recorded but nobody owns the follow-up actions
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: An incident has been documented without assigning responsibility for the follow-up.

before_after.title: Different funders apply incompatible reporting or eligibility requirements
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The same service must satisfy funding rules that ask for different evidence or accept different care needs.

before_after.title: An empty room stays unfilled while families cannot find a suitable place
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Available capacity and families’ searches do not connect to an agreed, suitable admission.

before_after.title: Our records do not explain why a care decision was made
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The record describes the action taken but leaves the reasoning difficult for others to follow.

before_after.title: A complaint process excludes people who cannot use written forms
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Raising a concern depends on a written route some people cannot use.

before_after.title: Building repairs repeatedly disrupt the spaces residents rely on
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Repair work takes place in areas residents still need for their usual daily routines.

before_after.title: A volunteer stops attending and a resident loses a valued regular visit
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: A valued relationship depends on a volunteer’s attendance without continuity when visits stop.

before_after.title: A worker cannot enter a client's home and there is no clear next step
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The provider needs to decide what happens to a planned visit when access to the home fails.

before_after.title: A resident's wishes for end-of-life care are missing when urgent decisions arise
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Urgent care choices must be made without a usable record of the resident’s preferences.

before_after.title: A resident's priorities change but their care plan stays the same
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The documented arrangement no longer reflects what the resident currently wants from daily care.

before_after.title: Symptoms are recorded separately and an emerging cluster is missed
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Separate symptom reports are not brought together in time to recognise a possible shared pattern.

before_after.title: A transfer aid is unavailable when a resident needs to move
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Movement assistance is needed before the team can obtain the appropriate transfer equipment.

before_after.title: We cannot give families a reliable answer about when a place will become available
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: A family needs to plan, but the provider cannot yet commit to an admission date.

before_after.title: Changing systems would lock us into costs or data arrangements we do not understand
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: A purchasing decision must account for future costs and access to data before changing systems.

before_after.title: Staff lack usable information about a resident's language, habits and important relationships
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The team plans everyday care without a usable account of what feels familiar or important to the resident.

before_after.title: Workers hesitate to report a near miss because they expect blame
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Workers’ concerns about blame make near-miss reporting difficult for the team.

before_after.title: A resident's preferred routine conflicts with our standard timetable
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The resident’s preferred timing does not fit the timetable used to organise shared care work.

before_after.title: Relatives cannot reach someone who can explain a change near the end of life
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: An important change happens when relatives cannot reach a staff member able to explain it.

before_after.title: A resident's needs increase but staffing hours do not adjust
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: The care arrangement must respond to greater support needs within the hours already allocated.

before_after.title: Contracted cleaning does not cover the times or spaces care staff actually need
before_after.previous_context: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
before_after.new_context: Cleaning arrangements miss the areas or hours needed to support the care team’s actual routine.

browser.scope: Two representative branches plus one edited situation detail; all40 separately checked through the production projection. Not a40-tile pixel inspection or venture-builder usability test.

research_scope.method: Human-authored editorial clarification of already published knowledge-generated hypotheses; no clinical, legal or operational advice, observation, prevalence, service adequacy or quantified harm asserted.

remaining_gaps: 349 generic context lines still remain. This batch does not prove human-need validity or adequate coverage.
Most situations still need researched alternatives and empirical quantification. Neutral illustrations remain while image generation is paused.
